## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] No new dependencies
- [ ] Commits are small and use a conventional prefix (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...)
- [ ] User-visible change: README or docs updated
- [ ] Security-sensitive change (token, Host/Origin checks, hooks, rule validation): test added, SECURITY.md updated if the model changed
